Task: Measure the area twice and sketch it with dimensions
Check whether a permit or approval is required with your local authority
Check for buried services before digging (call your local utility-locate service)
Calculate materials and add a waste allowance
Get at least two quotes or price checks
Confirm product yields / coverage from the packaging or data sheet
Arrange delivery access and a place to store materials
Hire or buy tools; check safety equipment (gloves, eye protection, dust mask)
Check the weather forecast for concrete, mortar or outdoor work
Prepare and compact the base / substrate
Store spare materials from the same batch for repairs
Record what you used for future reference
